label: Bounded search trees
subgoals: Branch on the endpoints of an uncovered edge
Decrease the budget by the vertices taken
Solve the recurrence for the leaf count

label: Kernelization: forced vertices
subgoals: Find a vertex of degree greater than the budget
Put it in the cover and lower the budget

label: The kernel size bound
subgoals: Bound the remaining edges by its square
Reject when the graph has more edges than the bound
